decisions.reason: The sewer pipe cleaning box is close to the firm's utility-facing fabricated metal and surface-treatment know-how, so management is likely to keep learning and refining it rather than exit quickly.

Public waste bins use the firm's metal fabrication, coating and public-sector sales capabilities, though they are somewhat farther from its fluid-handling core and therefore face moderate review risk.
Ground sleeves for posts are a straightforward adjacent metal product that fits existing processing, standard-model production and contractor/public-buyer channels.
Cast iron ground sleeves sit less naturally with the firm's stated steel and stainless processing base, so absorptive capacity to improve the product is weaker and portfolio pruning is more likely.
Steel ground sleeves strongly leverage the firm's steel-processing, finishing and certified production capabilities, making retention likely unless demand is clearly poor.
